[[File:Security_lock.jpg|thumb|right|A security lock with wetter plate indicated]]
A '''wetter plate''' was part of a [[security lock]]. Wiring the negative cable of an [[ignition switch]] to the wetter plate along with wiring positive cable into the [[boreen]] created a simple lock pick.
